description: Two cars 30 m apart at 80 km/h, full right lock for 1.0 s, one with the handbrake: its heading changes at least 1.4 times as much, and it is drifting at 0.5 s. SEDAN on the drive strip in the gear the auto-box holds at its start speed, raw AI controller (unsmoothed, unscaled inputs), the car ticking after the test, physics in step with game time (time dilation 0.25).
